entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, you can help me by fixing this absolute mess. I bought a jersey from you people over a month ago and it's completely useless! This is unacceptable!
I'm very sorry to hear that you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into this for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

What's the issue? The issue is it's the wrong size! It's ridiculously too tight! I look like a sausage casing. Your sizing charts are a complete lie and I want a refund immediately. This is the last time I order from VeloFit.
I understand your frustration, and I apologize that the fit wasn't what you expected. I can certainly check your return options. Do you happen to have your order number?

Yes, it's VF8675309. And don't tell me I'm outside some window. I expect a full refund, and if I don't get it, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. I want to speak to your manager!
I understand you're upset, and I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing to escalate. One moment while I pull up that order... Okay, I see it. The jersey was delivered 38 days ago.
Here we go. I knew it. You're going to tell me I'm out of luck, aren't you?

Not at all. According to our policy for standard apparel, you are well within the 90-day return period. I can process a full refund for you right now, no problem. If you'd prefer, I can also set up an exchange for a larger size.
Oh. A full refund? You're not going to fight me on this?
Absolutely not. You're well within the policy. We want you to be happy with your gear. Would you prefer the refund or the exchange?
Well... okay. That's... better. Just process the refund. I'll handle reordering myself later.

Of course. I have just initiated that for you. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid return shipping label in the next few minutes. Just send the jersey back in its original packaging, and we'll process the refund as soon as we receive it. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
